name: recurpost
description: Schedule and publish social media posts through your RecurPost account.
long_description: Connects Claude to RecurPost so you can list your connected social accounts and content libraries, post or schedule content, add evergreen content to a library, review posting history, and generate post copy or images with AI. Requires a RecurPost account and an API Password Key from Account Settings.

email.title: RecurPost email
email.description: The email address you log in to RecurPost with.

api_key.title: API Password Key
api_key.description: Generate one in RecurPost under Account Settings > API Password Key. This is not your login password.
